headline: Indian IT services showed solid revenue growth with AI emerging as a key driver in Q2 FY27.
summary: TCS posted ₹73,188 cr revenue and a 24% operating margin, confirming steady growth. HCLTech delivered 3% QoQ revenue rise and a 21% YoY profit increase, citing strong AI sales. Several peers have not yet reported results, keeping the broader picture incomplete.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI contributions, with TCS reaching $3.1 bn annualized AI revenue and HCLTech reporting a 78% YoY jump in AI revenue.

themes.title: Profit acceleration
themes.detail: HCLTech posted a 21% YoY rise in net profit, while TCS maintained a healthy 24% operating margin.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and strong operating margin with positive AI revenue signal.
Profit growth outpaced revenue, driven by AI sales and clear FY27 guidance.
